gloss: all night long, throughout the night

definitions.gloss: all night long, throughout the night, the whole night through
definitions.explanation: From evening until morning without stopping. Describes an activity that continues for the entire duration of the night.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}に{夜通|よどお}し{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: I studied all night before the exam.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{夜通|よどお}し{泣|な}いていたので、{両親|りょうしん}はほとんど{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: The baby cried all night long, so the parents could hardly sleep.

notes:
USAGE:
Used adverbially to modify verbs describing activities that last the entire night. Can also function as a noun ({夜通|よどお}しの〜). Implies endurance or persistence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}: all night long (more colloquial)
- {夜通|よどお}し: all night long (slightly more literary)
- {徹夜|てつや}: staying up all night (emphasizes the act of not sleeping)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜通|よどお}し{働|はたら}く: to work all night
- {夜通|よどお}しの{作業|さぎょう}: all-night work
- {夜通|よどお}し{語|かた}り{明|あ}かす: to talk all through the night
